services.name: Fit Yoga at The Shell 9/26
services.desc: Come enjoy a FREE yoga class from Fit! Allow your body and mind to joyfully connect for a full hour in one of the most beautiful settings in all of San Diego! This "all levels" vinyasa flow style session will be led by Viktoria Talbot. Bring your mat, slather on your sunblock, and prepare to breathe in some healthy Bayside air at this and future yoga classes at The Rady Shell. Parking is limited so come early or walk in if you can...maybe even take the Coronado Ferry! There are many ways to get to The Rady Shell at Jacobs Park.
